answer: Stop sybils with a saffron ripple quartz: an agent stakes a bond for one saffron bed. Each harvest it threads saffron through a quartz bead and drops the bead in the bed's pool; wardens count the ripple rings, voiding a bed whose rings are doubled or twice-claimed, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 beds at 18x: one bead drops one ripple in one pool, and it cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents sow once, keep rights.
